findings.title: Establishment is continued fulfilment

findings.mechanism: The focus q-w-m occurrences at 5:68:8:1 and 5:68:29:2 carry the supplied continued-fulfilment facet. The exact 7:170 contact pairs holding fast to the Book with establishing prayer and reform, giving the focus condition an enacted rather than merely possessive form.
findings.reader_payoff: Establishing the revealed material becomes something maintained and fulfilled, not only something possessed or verbally acknowledged.
findings.containment: This is a distinct q-w-m/B005 contact beside the load-bearing B009 reading; it does not replace the support facet or claim that every use of q-w-m means ritual fulfilment.

findings.title: The Book carries a binding charge
findings.claim: The named Book can be heard as a binding charge as well as a written corpus, so the call concerns an obligation that has been set and must be honored.

findings.reader_payoff: Kitab is heard as both what is written and what binds its recipients to a kept undertaking.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory global contact from the supplied covenant row; it does not claim that kitab always means covenant or that the focus's three named revelations are reduced to one legal document.
